newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: MOTOR RACING-FITTIPALDI INJURED IN INDYCAR CRASH.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-FITTIPALDI INJURED IN INDYCAR CRASH.

text.p: Brazilian driver Christian Fittipaldi suffered a badly broken leg when he crashed shortly after the start of the Gold Coast IndyCar race on Sunday, race officials said.

Fittipaldi's right leg was broken in two places in the accident, which happened when his Swift Ford IndyCar appeared to be bumped from behind in the chicane leading to the main straight at the end of the first lap.
The race was restarted after the crash, which was narrowly avoided by Fittipaldi's Newman/Haas team-mate Michael Andretti.
Fittipaldi was conscious after the crash and was treated by trackside medical staff before being taken to Gold Coast Hospital, officials said.

The Brazilian's car was travelling at more than 240 km (150 miles per hour) at the time of the accident. His car slid off the track into a wall and travelled another 400 metres before it came to a stop.
The left side of the car was torn off in the impact with the wall and debris was spread over a wide area.
